ports.name: bootstrap
ports.rule: Server verifies entry and membership; SDK token is not workspace permission

ports.name: navigate
ports.rule: Preserve workspace and proposal target; adapter maps route to host URL

ports.name: pickResources
ports.rule: Optional native picker; shared picker provides equivalent workflow

ports.name: protectDraft
ports.input: Persisted draft status and save/revert handlers
ports.rule: Persist drafts before leaving Morrow; connector has no domain draft UI

ports.name: feedback
ports.rule: Short native notification; authoritative task state remains in shared UI

ports.name: returnToWorkspace
ports.rule: Connector-to-Morrow only; reauthenticate/recheck grants; no credential or customer data in URL
